newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent, gas oil down with NYMEX, fund selling.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent, gas oil down with NYMEX, fund selling.

text.p: IPE Brent crude and gas oil contracts were led down to the day's lows in the afternoon on the back of good selling on NYMEX heating oil and WTI crude contracts, brokers said.
"There's no fresh news there at all but NYMEX is selling off and we are snowed under with orders to sell as well," one commented.
February Brent dipped to a low of $23.11 a barrel, recovering slightly to notch up a loss of 21 cents at $23.15 by 1633 GMT. The contract expires at close of business on Thursday.
Brokers said good fund selling in the U.S. prompted the sharp drop.
"The funds are in there and selling heavily," another commented.
February gas oil lost some $1.75 to trade last at $212.00 a tonne. March and April were harder hit, both down $2 on the day at $205.25 and $197.50 respectively.
Technical indicators predicted the downward move with five and 15-day moving averages crossing over indicating a sell signal.
